title: Cheap material, hard to assemble
text: Cheap material, hard to assemble. I have the grey nightstand. It's very heavy and actually took two of us to bring the box inside. The color is very pretty blue toned grey. The assembly is ridiculously over complicated and difficult considering this is just a nightstand. And it's just not the best quality material either. There are definitely better options out there. We'll use it, but I sure won't buy another one.

product_metadata.title: Novogratz Owen Nightstand, Dove Gray
features: Add mid-century modern style to your Bedroom or guest room with the Novo Gratz owen Nightstand
Made of laminated particleboard and metal, the Gray Finish contrasts the Black Back panel of the cubby and hairpin legs for a fun and modern look

Place a reading lamp, alarm clock, and cell phone on the table Top. Store away reading glasses, notepad, and pen in the convenient drawer. The large open cubby is perfect for organizing your books and magazines
Finish your room with the entire owen collection for a coordinated look (each sold separately)

The Nightstand ships flat to your door and 2 adults are recommended to assemble. Top surface and open cubby can hold 40 lbs. The drawer will hold up to 15 lbs. Once assembled, the Nightstand measures to be 26.89”H x 19.69”W x 15.67”D
description: Bring some retro flair to your bedside with the Novogratz Owen Nightstand. The gray finish on the laminated particleboard contrasts the black back panel of the cubby for a fun look for your Nightstand. The black metal hairpin legs bring some mid-century modern style and add a unique look to your room. Have a place to set your cell phone, reading glasses, and alarm clock on the table top. The drawer is the perfect spot to store your journal, notepad, and pen. Organize your books and magazines in the large open cubby and have easy access to your nighttime reading material. The Nightstand ships flat to your door and requires assembly upon opening. Two adults are recommended to assemble. Once assembled, the Nightstand measures to be 26.89”H x 19.69”W x 15.67”D.
